name: Southeastern Textile Machinery
old_description: Founded in 1972, Southeastern Textile Machinery specializes in buying and selling all types of textile machinery. We take care of every aspect of buying and selling equipment, including dismantling, rigging, packing, loading, and shipping. Our production and administrative facilities are located in Danville, VA, and we operate on a global scale. We also sell new custom-designed parts and provide reconditioning services for tenter frame systems. Please do not hesitate to contact us if you require any specific machinery, or if you have any questions about the equipment offered on our website.
about:
Southeastern Textile Machinery was founded in 1972 in Danville, Virginia. The company operates from production and administrative facilities there and conducts business on a global scale.

The firm buys and sells all types of textile machinery, including complete factories, and manages every phase of the transaction—dismantling, rigging, packing, loading, and shipping. It also supplies new custom-designed parts and provides reconditioning services for tenter frame systems. In addition, the company reconditions heddles and drop wires, manufactures new stop-motion bars, and offers consulting and design services for complete tenter systems.

Its customers are textile manufacturers and factories seeking machinery such as tenter frames, coating machines, and related components. The company has handled equipment including Isotex coating machines and provides parts for tenter frame systems.

The company positions itself as a single-source solution for tenter frame needs, emphasizing American-made parts, experienced technicians for reconditioning, and the ability to design new systems to replace existing machinery.

name: Southern Fabrication Works
old_description: Southern Fabrication Works specializes in designing and building custom food processing equipment tailored to your plant’s specific needs. From vegetable processing and potato washing to rock traps and hydrocutting systems, we’ve got you covered. Whether you require new machinery or upgrades to existing systems, our engineering team will deliver innovative solutions that optimize your production line.
about:
Southern Fabrication Works was established in 1998 in Burley, Idaho, near the Twin Falls area. The company operates as a locally owned and operated business, focusing on custom food processing equipment from its Idaho facility.

The firm designs, engineers, and fabricates a range of stainless-steel equipment for food processing lines, including hydrocutters, food pumps, chain sizers, even flow bins, mud pumps, solids removal systems, soil extraction units, tapered roll systems, rock traps, and KW washers. Its in-house engineering department uses SolidWorks for 3D layout and design approval before construction. Manufacturing is performed in a full-service machine shop and large fabrication bays, supported by multiple field crews that handle demolition, installation, and plant remodels. The company also provides sanitary and industrial piping, silo and tank fabrication, spare parts, and R&D prototyping services.

Southern Fabrication Works serves the industrial food processing sector, with experience in vegetable, potato, and fish meal processing. Customers include food processing plants worldwide and OEMs seeking overflow production work. A noted partnership with Melni Connectors involves design optimization, material sourcing, and prototype manufacturing for connector products.

The company emphasizes engineering excellence, premium-grade materials, and customized solutions designed to boost productivity, maintain hygiene, and ensure longevity. It protects client trade secrets by referring to competitors as "Brand X" and calculates theoretical production volumes conservatively, adjusting ratings based on customer feedback.

name: Southern Industrial Fabrics
old_description: Founded in 1980, Southern Industrial Fabrics has a long-standing legacy of producing performance-driven fabrics for demanding industries. We are proudly based in the USA and manufacture all fabrics in-house, offering customers high-quality, responsive service and engineering support.
about:
Founded in 1980, Southern Industrial Fabrics operates from Rossville, Georgia, where it has built a legacy of producing performance-driven fabrics for demanding industries. The company manufactures all fabrics in-house at its U.S. facility, offering customers engineering support and responsive service.

The company produces custom-engineered woven and knit fabrics using fibers such as polyester, nylon, cotton, polypropylene, para-aramid, meta-aramid, modacrylic, and PTFE. Its in-house facility runs more than 30 looms across multiple shifts, capable of weaving plain, basket, twill, drill, sateen, oxford, dobby, and specialty constructions at widths from 45 to 92 inches and weights from 2 to 30 ounces per square yard. Services span fiber and yarn selection, fabric engineering, weaving, dyeing, coating, testing, sampling, and full commercial production, with no minimum order quantity for custom development.

Southern Industrial Fabrics serves hospitality, aerospace, defense, automotive, energy, industrial, telecommunications, building construction, and consumer products. Applications include filtration media for liquid and air systems, industrial matting for reinforcement and liners, composite fabrics for multi-functional layers, and woven substrates for coating and lamination.

The company emphasizes 100 percent domestic manufacturing, quick turnaround, and engineering collaboration from concept through prototype to production. Its mission is to deliver custom textile solutions that solve real-world challenges reliably, efficiently, and with integrity, making it a reliable source for industries with domestic sourcing requirements such as defense and automotive.

name: Southern Interconnect
old_description: Southern Interconnect is an electronic manufacturing service company located in Houston, Texas. We provide custom cable assemblies and fully integrated systems manufactured and delivered to our customer’s specifications. We build panels, control boxes and cables from 30 AWG to 4/0. We utilize our expertise in high reliability manufacturing to exceed our customer expectations by continually delivering high quality product on time. Our goals are to deliver the best product, the best service and the best value in the industry.
about:
Southern Interconnect is an electronic manufacturing service company based in Houston, Texas. The company traces its origins to 1995, though specific founder names and ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The shop specializes in custom cable assemblies, wire harnesses, panel and control box builds, and printed circuit board assembly, handling wire gauges from 30 AWG to 4/0. It also provides electrical and mechanical assembly, turnkey manufacturing with MRP-coordinated procurement, quick-turn prototype services, concurrent engineering, design-for-manufacturability and design-for-testability reviews, and materials procurement with supplier lifecycle management. Quality management and KANBAN delivery round out the service portfolio.

Customers span oil and gas (fracking trailers, artificial lift controllers, hazardous-location cables), defense (mil-spec cables for vehicles and weapon systems), infrastructure (tower lighting, turbine fan controls, mobile generation cabling, UL-listed generator cables, GPS survey and dredging equipment), industrial (automation, test equipment, machine cables, OEM cables, KANBAN production), transportation (fleet tracking, traffic control, OBD cabling), and renewable energy (battery, solar panel, charge controller, inverter and fuse cables, underground and above-ground installations).

The company emphasizes high-reliability manufacturing expertise and on-time delivery, backed by an MRP system that coordinates procurement, production and shipping to meet committed dates. It also highlights quick-turn prototype support and concurrent engineering as key differentiators.

name: Southland Steel Fabricators, Inc.
old_description: Founded in 1986, Southland Steel Fabricators is owned and operated by the Lombardo family. Built upon the philosophy of hard work and ethical business practices, our company has grown immensely over the years and is now one of the largest steel fabricators in the region.
about:
Southland Steel Fabricators, Inc. was founded in 1986 in Greensburg, Louisiana. The company is owned and operated by the Lombardo family, built on a philosophy of hard work and ethical business practices. It has grown to become one of the largest steel fabricators in the region.

The firm provides a full spectrum of steel fabrication services, including 3D modeling (using SDS/2), engineering, structural and miscellaneous steel fabrication, in-house detailing, project management, and quality assurance. Its 300,000-square-foot fabrication facility houses CNC technology, while a separate 20,000-square-foot coating plant handles fireproofing, galvanizing, and complex industrial coatings. A workforce of more than 200 professionals supports high-volume production capabilities.

Southland Steel serves customers in the steel fabrication industry, with projects ranging from 1,000 to 24,000 tons and values up to $120 million. Its centralized location near Interstates 10 and 12 and the ports of New Orleans and Baton Rouge enables efficient shipping to regional and national clients.

The company emphasizes competitive pricing, innovative scheduling, and personalized service stemming from family ownership, aiming to deliver projects on time, on budget, and to the highest quality standards.

name: Southwest Wire Rope Inc
old_description: Southwest Wire Rope was established in 1966 to meet a strong demand for reliable service and quality wire rope required by industries along the Gulf Coast. Since those early years, we have expanded and increased our product line to meet diversified markets around the world. Today, we are a prime supplier of material handling, lifting & mooring products globally.
about:
Southwest Wire Rope Inc was founded in 1966 in New Iberia, Louisiana, to address demand for reliable wire rope and rigging products from industries along the Gulf Coast. The company began as a supplier of wire rope and related hardware, expanding its product line over the decades to serve diversified markets worldwide.

The company operates three full-service locations in Texas and Louisiana, stocking a complete range of lifting products including wire rope slings, nylon slings, round slings, chain, shackles, thimbles, sockets, and other hardware. Beyond distribution, Southwest Wire Rope provides engineering services such as engineered lifting device design, lift planning, and load testing up to 1.5 million pounds. Its fabrication shop produces below-the-hook lifting devices—spreader bars, spreader beams, lifting beams, lifting frames, padeyes, reel lifters, and custom assemblies—designed to ASME B30.20 and BTH-1 standards. Additional services include field spooling of wire and synthetic rope (under the Haynes Wire Rope trade name), on-site rigging gear inspections using Tessalink software, and lifting gear rentals.

Southwest Wire Rope serves industries along the Gulf Coast and global markets, including oil and gas, marine, construction, and heavy industrial sectors. Its customer base comprises rigging professionals, drilling contractors, crane operators, and engineering firms requiring certified lifting solutions and compliance with standards such as DNV, API, and ABS.

The company differentiates itself through its ISO 9001:2015 quality management system certified by DNV, the proprietary Gold Strand wire rope trademark introduced in 1983, and in-house testing capabilities calibrated to ASTM E4. Engineering expertise is backed by professional engineers who perform structural calculations using Mathcad, SolidWorks, and ANSYS finite element analysis, validated by proof load testing.

name: Spartronics
old_description: In Watertown, South Dakota, Spartronics manufactures complex electronic and electromechanical products for medical, life science, aerospace, and instrumentation and control applications for FDA-regulated, mission-critical, and high-cost-of-failure industrial environments. We partner with our customers along the entire manufacturing value chain, providing engineering, prototyping, manufacturing, test engineering, supply chain management and aftermarket services.
about:
Spartronics operates a 100,000-square-foot electromechanical manufacturing facility in Watertown, South Dakota. The company provides contract manufacturing services for complex electronic and electromechanical products across regulated industries.

The facility specializes in printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) using surface-mount, through-hole, and flex-circuit technologies, along with electromechanical sub-assembly and full box-build integration. Capabilities include automated optical inspection, X-ray inspection, flying-probe and in-circuit testing, environmental stress screening, conformal coating, and functional test development. The site supports new product introduction (NPI), prototyping, and volume production, backed by supply chain management and aftermarket services such as repair, refurbishment, and obsolescence management.

Spartronics serves medical device, life sciences, instrumentation and control, commercial aerospace, defense, and space sectors. Customers include original equipment manufacturers requiring FDA-registered, ISO 13485-certified production for devices such as cardiovascular monitors, neuroablation systems, patient-warming equipment, and RF audio transmission modules. The company also supports aerospace and defense programs requiring AS9100 and ITAR compliance.

The company emphasizes a holistic product ownership mentality, combining in-house PCBA and top-level assembly under one roof. Its quality system adheres to standards including ISO 9001:2015, ISO 13485:2016, AS9100, IEC 60601-1, and IPC-A-610 Class III, with dedicated project managers and cross-functional teams for each program.

name: Specialty Cable Corporation
old_description: Specialty Cable Corporation (SCC) engineers and manufactures wire and cable products that deliver top performance while meeting or exceeding customer specifications.  Along the way, we’ve developed some unique manufacturing methods like our proprietary printing technique that ensures absolutely repeatable high quality results from start to finish.
about:
Founded in 1942 as a division of Lewis Engineering Company in Naugatuck, Connecticut, Specialty Cable Corporation (SCC) began producing highly engineered wire and cable for military and aerospace applications. The company now operates a 65,000‑square‑foot facility in Wallingford, Connecticut.

SCC engineers and manufactures a range of wire and cable products, including Mil‑spec aerospace cables for engine and airframe systems, audio interconnect cables optimized for distortion‑free transmission, and cables used in medical heart monitors and fetal monitoring equipment. The company has developed proprietary manufacturing methods such as a printing technique that ensures repeatable quality, and it produces cables rated for temperatures from –150 °C to over 1,400 °C, with resistance to chemicals and precise dimensional control.

The company serves aerospace, defense, medical, audio, and industrial markets. Its products are found in aircraft engine control systems, fetal heart monitors, and other demanding applications requiring high reliability in hostile environments.

SCC emphasizes a value‑engineered philosophy, aiming to provide the right solution at a sensible price even for small quantities. Its quality system is certified to AS9100D and ISO 9001:2015, and the company highlights its ability to apply technologies across markets to solve custom cable challenges.

name: Specialty Plastics & Fab Inc
old_description: Is a leading manufacturer and distributor of fluid processing and handling equipment. We service a wide range of markets, including semiconductor, solar, water, wastewater, biomedical, hospital, lab, mining, food processing, and many more. Our reputation for excellence in custom fabrication, machining, distribution, and quality control protocol, along with our loyal customer base, has made us a leader in the plastics industry.
about:
Specialty Plastics & Fabrication, Inc. (SPF) operates from Boise, Idaho, where it has served the Treasure Valley for more than three decades as a family‑owned and operated business. The company describes itself as the region’s oldest and largest stocking distributor of industrial process piping components and a custom plastic fabrication shop.

SPF manufactures and distributes fluid processing and handling equipment, offering custom fabrication, CNC machining, and distribution of valves, pumps, tanks, plastic sheets, and pipe. The facility runs three MultiCam CNC router tables (4’×8’, 5’×10’, 6’×10’), a HAAS ST10 CNC lathe, and a HAAS VF3 machining center with a fourth axis, supporting both automated and manual machining. The shop specializes in low‑volume, non‑traditional jobs while also accommodating high‑volume traditional production runs.

Customers span semiconductor, solar, water and wastewater treatment, biomedical, hospital and laboratory, mining, food processing, and aerospace sectors. SPF provides tailored solutions for projects of all sizes, from specialized components to complete piping systems.

The company emphasizes a quality program certified to ISO 9001:2015, competitive pricing, and a mission built on long‑term customer and vendor relationships. Its differentiators include deep stock of high‑purity and industrial plastic piping, in‑house fabrication capacity, and a commitment to delivering products that meet exacting industry standards.

name: Spice World Inc
old_description: The founder of Spice World, Andy “Pops” Caneza, had the ambition of sharing flavor all year long by using the freshest garlic available. For over 75 years, this commitment to quality, availability, and convenience has been the reason why we are “America’s Favorite Garlic.” Pops’ passion for delivering fresh flavor is seen in all our products, but it may just be more apparent in our people. Today, that passion continues in the Spice World Family.
about:
Spice World Inc was founded in 1949 in Orlando, Florida, by Andy "Pops" Caneza, who wanted to make fresh garlic flavor available year‑round. The company began with a focus on sourcing the freshest garlic and has maintained that commitment for over 75 years.

Today Spice World processes and packages a range of fresh‑flavor products including peeled and ready‑to‑use garlic, squeezable ginger, minced and chopped onion (sold as Easy Onion), fresh shallots, seasoning blends, and pesto. The operation follows a "follow the sun" sourcing model to secure consistent quality and availability, and it packages its output in convenient jars and squeezable bottles for both retail and food‑service channels.

The brand serves home cooks, professional chefs, and institutional partners; its community of chefs contributes recipes, and it holds a promotional partnership with the Orlando City and Orlando Pride soccer teams to develop co‑branded recipes.

The founder's original goal — sharing flavor without seasonal limits — still drives the company's emphasis on convenience, quality, and innovation, summed up in its "Flavor Without Boundaries" philosophy.
